payload.title: Drop the archived taskgrind state ignore
payload.body:
Details: taskgrind is archived; nothing writes .taskgrind-state any more.
- **Hypothesis**: taskgrind mentions outside dated notes go 1 to 0.
- **Measurement**: git grep -n -i taskgrind -- .gitignore
- **Success**: 0 hits.
- **Pivot**: a needed workflow still writes the file.
- **Anchor**: Basili et al. 1994 (GQM).
